_doc: Stream C (Expansion 1). Quests for zone 'fumarole_fen' on Vharlen, the Burning Isle. Format: data/quests/README.md. Rewards: xp = share of a level's XP at the quest level, gold = multiple of a kill's gold; item.tier rolls at your level. `killRare` {zone, slot} names the zone's rare by slot (data/provinces/rares.json). Story-chain quests carry `story: n` (data/quests/vharlen-province.json).

mother_imma.name: Mother Imma
mother_imma.greeting: Up the ladder, mind the third rung. The fen breathes under us. Lately it breathes badly.

stilt_builder_oskel.name: Stilt-builder Oskel
stilt_builder_oskel.greeting: Every house in Stiltreach is mine. Every house that is leaning is not.

fennu_draskar.name: Fennu Draskar
fennu_draskar.greeting: Mud-eels, boiled in the mud they live in. Saves on firewood.

angler_stiltreach.name: Pirra Nuvaru
angler_stiltreach.greeting: I fish off my own doorstep. The doorstep is three men high. See the ripples, just south-east of where I'm standing? That's the town pool. It never fishes out.

carter_stiltreach.name: Velu Karrovu
carter_stiltreach.greeting: I do not go fast, I do not go near vents, and I do not stop for raiders. Fares are on the board.

quests.name: Mud in the Channels
quests.offer: The mudback lurkers lean on my stilts to scratch their backs. One good scratch and a family ends up in the mud with their breakfast.

steps.text: Kill 6 mudback lurkers in the mud channels

quests.done: Nothing has leaned on anything all morning. I almost miss it. No, I do not.

quests.name: The Fen Breathes Wrong
quests.offer: Yellowpan sent you with a nose full of sulphur. Good, you will know the smell. Slagborn wade out at dusk and tip sacks into our vents. Now the wisps come up thick and yellow and the whole fen coughs all night. Clear the vents and bring me what they are pouring.

steps.text: Kill 8 vent wisps at the fumaroles
Gather 4 burnt sulphur cakes from the vent wisps
Bring the cakes to Mother Imma in Stiltreach

quests.done: Slagborn bread. This is what they feed the Mother, to make her hungry. The ash-reader in Cinderholt knows what happened the last time someone fed her. Go and ask.

quests.name: Old Mudlord
quests.offer: The biggest lurker in the fen is so old the mud has grown over him. Old Mudlord. He does not lean on stilts. He eats them.

steps.text: Kill 4 mudback lurkers to stir him up

steps.where: the deep channels of Fumarole Fen

quests.done: I will build a house where he used to lie. Very warm. Very quiet.

quests.name: Bubblejaw
quests.offer: There is a mouth in the fen that blows bubbles. When the bubbles pop, a fisher goes missing. I have done the sums. It is Bubblejaw.

steps.where: the bubbling pools of Fumarole Fen

quests.done: No more bubbles. I will boil you an eel. You will not like it, but it is the thought.

quests.name: The Drowned Vent
quests.offer: Under the fen is a vent the water got into long ago. It should be cold and dead. It has started to glow. Take friends, and take something that floats.

steps.text: Swim down into the Drowned Vent
steps.where: The Drowned Vent, the dungeon door in Fumarole Fen

steps.text: Defeat what lit the bottom of the Drowned Vent
steps.where: the bottom of The Drowned Vent

quests.done: Dark and cold again, as a drowned thing should be. Cinderholt could use hands like yours; they are digging out their cellars and not liking what they find.

quests.name: The Fen Breath
quests.offer: Some nights the whole fen breathes in at once, and what comes out is not steam. We call it the Fen Breath. When the horn goes, come out on the boards with a weapon.

steps.where: the open fen, when the horn sounds (zone event)
steps.text: Defeat the Fen Breath when it rises

quests.done: The fen breathes out, and it is only steam again. Good. Go and soak somewhere.
